project_name: Supplier Portal Dashboard, ESG Modules & OCR Extraction Refactor
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY WITH PRECISION SaaS DASHBOARD
theme: Light mode primary with emerald/slate high-contrast accents

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl font-bold text-emerald-950 sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight

layout_and_structure.page_container: mx-auto w-full max-w-[1700px] space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8
layout_and_structure.header_pattern: ModulePageHeader with title, icon, and aside action controls
layout_and_structure.ocr_workspace_layout: Full width stacked/responsive layout with compact header controls

ocr_refactor_requirements.page_header: Use ModulePageHeader with title 'OCR Extraction', icon FileText or Sparkles, and matching Bulk Upload style (data-testid='ocr-invoice-header').
ocr_refactor_requirements.remove_hero_copy: COMPLETELY REMOVE the introductory banner block containing 'Secure organization workspace Activity extraction Convert invoices and ledgers into reviewable Scope 1, 2 and 3 activity data.'
ocr_refactor_requirements.extraction_mode_relocation: Shift Fast/Think extraction mode selector into the header action area / right-aligned inline toolbar where the Download template button is located.
ocr_refactor_requirements.extraction_mode_compact_buttons: Compact the Fast and Think mode buttons by removing the summary text ('Rapid extraction and classification' / 'Deeper reasoning for complex documents'). Display title, model badge, and icon in a clean pill/toggle group.
ocr_refactor_requirements.full_width_workspace: Allow source document preview, upload dropzone, batch queue, and line items review table to acquire full width across the grid without unnecessary multi-column sidebars when hero is cleared.

manual_ghg_create_form_fix.state_synchronization_bug: Fix payload unit mismatch where 'kg' was randomly sent instead of the selected unit (e.g., 'kl' or 'L').
manual_ghg_create_form_fix.resolution_rule: Ensure form state synchronization listens directly to the unit dropdown change handler and updates both internal state and dispatch payload atomically. Validate unit payload prior to POST/PUT API dispatch.

testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive and key informational element (e.g. data-testid='ocr-mode-fast-button', data-testid='ocr-download-template-button', data-testid='ocr-review-table')

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor frontend/src/pages/OCRInvoice.js and frontend/src/modules/ocr/ExtractionModeSelector.jsx to fulfill all user explicitly requested UI changes.
Integrate ModulePageHeader in OCRInvoice.js using icon={FileText} or icon={Sparkles} and title='OCR Extraction'.
Remove legacy hero copy banner from OCRInvoice.js.
Move Fast/Think mode selector into the ModulePageHeader header action area (aside slot) or header toolbar.
Reduce Fast/Think selector button sizes by removing the text 'Rapid extraction and classification' and 'Deeper reasoning for complex documents'.
Expand UploadWorkspace, DocumentPreview, and OcrReviewTable to take full width.

Verify and fix unit state synchronization in GHG Create form (e.g., DynamicFieldRenderer.js or EmissionEntryForm.js / useEmissionFormState.js) so unit changes like 'kl' or 'L' are accurately reflected in submission payload instead of falling back to 'kg'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select/input elements.
Maintain high APCA contrast across all interactive states; hover states must explicitly declare text color.
Ensure glassmorphism and header containers always have background opacities (never pure transparent background).
Attach data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, tables, headers, and modal actions.
